services.label: Services
services.title: What I can do for you
services.subtitle: From architecture to deployment — clean, scalable, production-ready.
services.api_desc: Thoughtful API and database design as the foundation for scalable systems. REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and clean system boundaries.
services.backend_desc: Scalable backend systems with Python and FastAPI. Clean code and robust test coverage — production-ready from the start.
services.data_desc: Data architecture and ETL pipelines. From raw data ingestion to a clean, actionable data foundation.
services.ai_desc: Integrating AI models and LLMs into production systems — with evaluation, observability, and scaling, so AI doesn't stop at the prototype stage.
services.devops_desc: CI/CD pipelines, containerised deployments, and end-to-end observability — so software ships fast, safely, and reliably.
services.cloud_desc: Cloud architectures on Azure, GCP, and AWS — provisioned with Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: From backend architecture to AI integration — a selection of my freelance projects.
portfolio.item1_desc: AI-powered platform for automatic metadata extraction from video content — plotlines, characters, scenes. Microservices architecture on GCP with secure authentication, observability via OpenTelemetry, and LLM integration.
portfolio.item2_desc: Modular AI workflow system for creative production teams on Azure. Deep-research workflows and GenAI-powered image generation with LangChain, monitoring with LangSmith.
portfolio.item3_desc: Data platform on Azure. ETL pipelines with Databricks and Azure Synapse, high security requirements following OWASP standards.
portfolio.item4_desc: Retrieval-Augmented Generation system with autonomous agents connected to structured and unstructured data sources. OpenAI integration, vector database with QDrant, full observability setup with OpenTelemetry and Langfuse.

about.label: About me
about.p1: During my Bioinformatics studies, I discovered programming as a tool — to understand data, automate processes, and answer scientific questions.
about.p2: Joined a startup as a working student, hired full-time shortly after. Three years of client projects: real systems, real problems, real deadlines. That's where I learned the craft — backend development, data pipelines, various cloud environments. From idea to go-live.
about.p3: Freelance since January 2024, with over 6 years of experience across the full stack: Software, Data, AI, and Cloud. My studies shaped analytical thinking; practice sharpened my eye for systems that need to deliver.
about.p4: I work in a structured way, communicate directly, and deliver in short iterations — so projects don't just start, they get done.
